rooms.name: In a Marsh
rooms.desc:
The ground becomes ever softer and yeilds and springs with every step.
Mosquitoes buzz in your ear and find even the smallest chink in your armor to
bite at the tender flesh underneath. A nauseating stench comes from the 
south, heralding the start of a swamp. To the east and west huge ironwood 
trees can be seen rising up into the sky.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The solid ground of the forest gives way to a wet spongy terrain. The
ground squishes under each footfall and the thoguht of falling through is
first in mind. The trees are becoming slightly more spread out, but the
maze of roots coming from them more than makes up for any difference in 
ease of passage. The sounds of moving water come from the east. To the south
the swamp seems to be getting more dense.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river takes a turn to the east here, and stretches as far as you can see
to the north. To the west the swamp thickens with fog.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river runs south from here, sweeping in from the west toward the great
forest to the northeast.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The swamplands border the forest here; the tall trees block your view of the 
horizon to the north and west. Southeast of here the dismal swamp beckons
to you with the hoarse cries of bullfrogs... and strong sense of evil.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The fast flowing niche to the east deposits you into this relatively 
slow flowing pond. Everywhere small tributaries deposit their loads from 
the river into this area. Every direction is open for travel. To the north
it looks as though it may get drier.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The fast flowing water to the east seems to have carved a small canal
into the swamp at this point. The water funnels into this canal bringing 
you along for the ride. The movement through this passage is quite fast and
keeping from tipping over on slightly submerged roots is of top priority. 
After the small passage the water opens into the stillness of the open swamp

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The raging river runs due south here, marking the border between the forest to
the east and swamp to the west.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
A tangled growth of lush forest opens to the north and west, but here the
ground is swampy and deep with grainy black water.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the west the tall spires of trees saturate your view, it looks as 
thought the swamp borders up to a forest in that direction. Every other 
direction seems to look the same, swamp. Here and there a small frog pops 
its head from the water and croaks at you.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Razor grass is everywhere, it's tall stalks coming from under the dark
surface of the water. It limits your sight to a few feet.  Exits are in
every direction.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The water here begins to slow and calm itself now that it's out of the fast-
moving river. The shores are made up of floating algae deposits between roots
of trees. The closer you get the more dense the foliage hanging from the trees
becomes. Branches are slapping you in the face as you try to push them out of
the way.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river twists madly, coming in from the north and curving to the south
just east of here. The swamp looms to the southwest.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river runs south and west here, bordering the swamp. Tall trees twice the
diameter of your reach block out the sun to the northeast.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Here ground and water meet once again. To the west lush trees and 
foilage begin to grow with renewd vengence as the marshy land gives was to 
solid soil. Birds twitter in the trees letting you know that the desolation
of the swamp lays behind you.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Razor grass is everywhere, it's tall stalks coming from under the dark
surface of the water. It limits your sight to a few feet.  Exits are in
every direction.

rooms.desc:
Razor grass is everywhere, it's tall stalks coming from under the dark
surface of the water. It limits your sight to a few feet.  Exits are in
every direction.

surface of the water. It limits your sight to a few feet.  Exits are in
every direction.

every direction.

moving river. The shores are made up of floating algae deposits between roots
of trees. The closer you get the more dense the foliage hanging from the trees
becomes. Branches are slapping you in the face as you try to push them out of
the way.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river running in from the north makes you fight to keep from being carried
southward. The forest east of here is a mirror opposite of the gloomy swamp
to the west.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the north and west a forest marks the edge of the swamp. Dark waters
swirl lazily about to the southeast.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

Razor grass is everywhere, it's tall stalks coming from under the dark
surface of the water. It limits your sight to a few feet.  Exits are in
every direction.

Razor grass is everywhere, it's tall stalks coming from under the dark

every direction.

The water here begins to slow and calm itself now that it's out of the fast-
moving river. The shores are made up of floating algae deposits between roots
of trees. The closer you get the more dense the foliage hanging from the trees
becomes. Branches are slapping you in the face as you try to push them out of
the way.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river makes a boundary between the swampy marsh to the west and the
luscious green forest to the east. The water flows swiftly in from the north   
and threatens to sweep you southward.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the west lies firmer ground housing a vast forest, but in all other 
directions only the sight of black swamp water meets your eyes.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The dark waters beneath you are teeming with life, most of it hungry. In
all directions the swamp extends.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The dark waters beneath you are teeming with life, most of it hungry. In
all directions the swamp extends.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The dark waters beneath you are teeming with life, most of it hungry. In
all directions the swamp extends.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Beneath you, swamp water suddenly boils with noxious swamp gas. Holding your
nose, you continue on.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The water here is relatively calm, and the insect life is beginning to
outnumber you by about a hundred to one. Pulling your cloak tight over your
unprotected skin, you keep moving.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The water here begins to slow and calm itself now that its out of the fast
moving river. The shores are made up of floating algae deposits between roots
of trees. The closer you get the more dense the foilage hanging from the trees
becomes. Branches are slapping you in the face as you try to push them out of
the way.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river borders the swamp to the south and west, coming in from the north
and continuing on to the east.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc: The river twists south and west, flowing past you in a foam-flecked rage.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
You stand on the edge of a vast swamp. North and west of here the land is
firmer, and giant ironwood trees rise into the air. The stench of rotting
vegetation fills the air.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Every now and then the boat runs up against
underwater debris of some sort. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Dark stagnant water extends in every direction. There is very little
ground visible in any direction. Every now and then the boat runs up against
underwater debris of some sort. Coming from all around you are the sounds 
of the local wildlife.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the east you hear the sounds of rushing water. The area you are entering
looks as thought it is just begining to regrow. From the burnt husks of trees
new life springs forth. Besides the sound of water from the east there is no
noise that greets your ears. The swamp is suspiciously silent.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the north and east a river flows by, almost covering the sound
of the the swamp creatures moving through the underbrush all around you.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The dark depths of the river flow under beneath you. To the west a swampy swath
of land dominates the horizon, and to the east a great forest bathes the
land in towering green foliage. The river continues north and south of here.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the west a forest lies, but in all other directions the bleak waters of
the swamp boil with hidden life.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc: To the south foxfire ignites as it escapes from beneath the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Razor grass grows up from the depths of the black swamp, and rotted stumps
make passage difficult. You long for dry land.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
A slight draft of warm wind brings the smell of ocean air to your nostrils. 
All around you the swamp opens up into murky depths.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc: You push through the dark swamp, searching for land.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you can see the roof of a small wooden shack. In all other
directions lies only the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you can see the roof of a small wooden shack. In all other
directions lies only the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the east you can hear the sound of moving water, and to the southwest
appears to be some sort of dwelling.  All is silent in this part of the
swamp, and fire damage is evident.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the east a river marks the boundary between the swamp surrounding you
and the forest on the other bank.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river makes an 'S' curve here, bending southward just east of here, and
flowing in from the north in a foamy white torrent.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river bends here, flowing in from the west and heading southward into a 
murky swamp. North of here a forest of gigantic proportions stretches into
the sky.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Murky swamp surrounds you in all directions, but there's a faint scent of
salt water in the air.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The black water flows slowly beneath you, sometimes swirling faintly as 
something disturbs the debris-dotted surface.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The black water beneath you suddenly boils as a noxious gas bubbles to the 
surface. Licks of foxfire burst in and out of existence.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Murky swamp surrounds you in all directions, but the smell of salt water is 
strong.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the southeast lies a stilt shack, and beyond it can be seen other dwellings
of the same type. Nothing moves in the deserted village.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south the side of a shack, built on stilts, blocks your passage. Beyond
it can be seen more buildings, though you see no signs of life. In all other
directions lies only more swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south lies a desolate village, not much more than a bunch of shacks
built on stilts. All is silent within.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south lies a deserted shanty town made of several wooden shacks built
on stilts. No movement can be seen, and the swamp is deathly quiet here.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the southwest lies a deserted shanty town, composed of several wooden
buildings built on stilts. In all other directions lies the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
You are between a rier to the northeast and a deserted shanty town to the
southwest. In all other directions the stagnant swamp waters lie calm.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
A river borders you to the north and east, winding its way to the ocean
far to the south.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river takes a turn south of here, heading east and picking up speed.
The swamp on either side of you makes you want to stick to the clear river.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The broken stumps of rotted trees thins to the south; through the fog you
can see a clear blue ocean.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Murky swamp surrounds you in all directions, but the smell of salt water is 
strong.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
You stand in the middle of a vast swamp. Rotted tree stumps rest in the
putrid quagmire beneath your feet.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Murky swamp surrounds you in all directions, but the smell of salt water is 
strong.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
Murky swamp surrounds you in all directions, but the smell of salt water is 
strong.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the east lies the back of a small stilt shack, and beyond it you can see
several buildings of the same type. Nothing moves in the deserted shanty town.

rooms.name: In a Stilt Shack
rooms.desc:
Light filters in from the doorway to the east and the cracks in the boards
all around you. Once a human dwelling, you now see that this building is a
nest of some kind... a nest for something very large.

rooms.name: Desolate village
rooms.desc:
All is silent in this seemingly deserted village. To the south a small patch
of land marks the center of "town". A stilt shack opens to the west.

rooms.name: Desolate village
rooms.desc:
To the south lies the side of wooden shack. Ankle-deep water flows here, but
to the southwest the ground is a little higher.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the west lies a deserted shanty town, made up of a few wooden stilt
shacks grouped around what obviously used to be a fresh-water spring. Nothing
moves within.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the northeast you can hear the sound of a running river, and to the west
can barely be seen the top of some sort of dwelling. All around, the swamp
is silent.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the east a river rages, bordered on it's other side by a thick forest. In
all other directions lies a forbidding swamp.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river takes a turn here, coming in from the north and heading east
out of the swamp and into a seemingly endless sea that looks quite inviting,
even from this distance.

rooms.name: The River
rooms.desc:
The river sweeps eastward into a clear blue sea, pouring in from the west
and spilling over its banks to create a boggy marsh to the south.

rooms.name: River Delta
rooms.desc:
The river pours madly into the ocean east of here, churning wildy until
it disperses among the calmer waves of the sea. A swampy marsh lies to
the south, and to the west the river continues.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
A warm ocean breeze wafts in from the southwest, where you spy a vast expanse
of ocean. To the north and east lies more black swamp land.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you can see the clear blue water of the ocean. In all other
directions the swamp surrounds you.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you spy a glimpse of a clear blue ocean. In all other directions
lies the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you spy a glimpse of a clear blue ocean. In all other directions
lies the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you spy a glimpse of a clear blue ocean. In all other directions
lies the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
A snake, about as long as you are tall, slithers through the shallow water
and disappears into a clump of peat. Around, the swamp is silent. To the east
lies the back of a stilt shack.

rooms.name: In a Stilt Shack
rooms.desc:
Light filters in from the doorway to the east and the cracks in the boards
all around you. Once a human dwelling, you now see that this building is a
nest of some kind... a nest for something very large.

rooms.name: Desolate village
rooms.desc:
This looks like it used to be the center of the small, ruined village. A pile
of stones marks where the well the inhabitants used to get clean water from. 
It's cover is still intact. Wooden stilt shacks stand to the northwest, west
and east. To the south you can catch a glimpse of ocean.

rooms.name: In a Stilt Shack
rooms.desc:
Light filters in from the doorway to the west and the cracks in the boards
all around you. Once a human dwelling, you now see that this building is a
nest of some kind... a nest for something very large.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the west lies the back of a wooden shanty, built on sturdy wooden stilts
that are now splintered with age. In all other directions lies the bleak swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the west you spy the roof of some sort of dwelling. A hot sea breeze blows
by constantly, warding off the odor of the stagnant swamp all around you.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the northeast lies a river, across which you can see a lush green forest
that contrasts well with the bleak swamp surrounding you.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the north a river makes a sharp bend eastward. Dismal swamp surrounds
you in all other directions.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
You are just inland on a penisulu jutting out into the sea. TO the north a
river pours into the ocean that surrounds you to the northeast and south.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
You are just south of the river delta that is formed as the river pours into
the ocean to the east. West of here the light is sucked into the blackness
of the swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc: The swamp meets the ocean here, the murky water spilling into clearer depths.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The coast stretches out the east and west, forming an indistinctive border
between the ocean to the south and the swamp to the north.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc: To the southwest the ocean surf placidly laps the murky swamp water.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
A small peninsula of land is formed to the south, a jut of swamp land sur-
rounded by clear blue ocean.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you can see the ocean. The swamp leers at you dismally from the
north.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south a break in the fog-laden trees of the swamp reveals a sparkling
blue ocean.
To the northeast several wooden shacks are built on stilts.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south a break in the fog-laden trees of the swamp reveals a sparkling
blue ocean. To the north lies the side of a wooden shack, built on stilts. It 
looks long deserted.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south a break in the fog-laden trees of the swamp reveals a sparkling
blue ocean. To the north lies the center of a what used to be an old stilt
town, though most of it now must lie under water.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south a break in the fog-laden trees of the swamp reveals a sparkling
blue ocean.
To the north the side of a stilt-shack rises slightly above the water 
line, and several other dwellings of the same type can be seen just past it.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the northwest a stilt shanty marks the corner or a long-deserted village. To
the south you catch a glimpse of the ocean, and in all other directions lies
more swamp.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you can see the ocean through the swamp brush, but in all other 
directions only gnarled stumps and rotten water greets your eyes.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
To the south you can see the ocean through the swamp brush, but in all other 
directions only gnarled stumps and rotten water greets your eyes.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
To the southeast the ocean waves roll in, mixing with the dark water of the
swamp here and carrying it out to sea. To the northwest the great swamp
rises before you.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
You are at the very edge of the ocean, where the swampy marsh turns into pure
saltwater with no real beach visible. The ocean stretches to the horizon
to the east, and swamp the west.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
You are just west of the ocean, on the swampy coast that meanders to the 
northeast where you see a river outlet, and to the southwest where the coast
curves out of sight. West of here lies a vast boggy marsh.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The coast forms a indistinctive border between the swamp to the north and the
ocean that surrounds you on the wouth and west sides of this murky peninsula.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The coast here is not much more than an indistinct line between the clear
water of the ocean to the south, and the murky slime of the swamp that
surrounds you in all other directions.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The coast here is not much more than an indistinct line between the clear
water of the ocean to the south, and the murky slime of the swamp that
surrounds you in all other directions.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The swamp ends to the south at the shores of a clear blue ocean. To the
north the swamp stretchs without ending.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The swamp ends to the south at the shores of a clear blue ocean. To the
north the swamp stretchs without ending.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The swamp ends to the south at the shores of a clear blue ocean. To the
north the swamp stretchs without ending.

rooms.name: The Swamp
rooms.desc:
The swamp ends to the south at the shores of a clear blue ocean. To the
north the swamp stretchs without ending.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The waters of the ocean lap the shores to the southeast. In all other dir-
ections the swamp stirs lazily.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The salty marsh turns into plain saltwater here, as the waves of the ocean
to the south become the swampy land that surrounds you in all other directions.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The salty marsh turns into plain saltwater here, as the waves of the ocean
to the south become the swampy land that surrounds you in all other directions.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The salty marsh turns into plain saltwater here, as the waves of the ocean
to the southeast become the swampy land that lies to the north and west.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The water of the ocean to the south and west laps against the murkier slime
the swamp here, forming an almost indistinct border to the bog to the north
and east.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The salty marsh turns into plain saltwater here, as the waves of the ocean
to the south become the swampy land that surrounds you in all other directions.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The salty marsh turns into plain saltwater here, as the waves of the ocean
to the south become the swampy land that surrounds you in all other directions.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The salty marsh turns into plain saltwater here, as the waves of the ocean
to the south become the swampy land that surrounds you in all other directions.

rooms.name: The Swamp Along the Coast
rooms.desc:
The ocean reaches inland here, creating a small putrid bay to the east where
it borders against the swamp. To the south the ocean is more clear, the
antithesis of the swamp to the north and west.

rooms.name: Under the Swamp
rooms.desc:
As you enter this room, the first thing you notice is the practically
unbearable stench; you almost retch at the thought of what could make such a
foul odor.  The second thing you notice is the source of the smell -- bodies,
at least twenty of them, with their rib cages ripped open so wide they look
like some twisted mockery of angels. There is nothing inside the carcasses,
their insides are strewn across a bloody stone altar in the center of the
room.
